```{r, include=FALSE}
library(splines)
library(ggplot2)
library(mgcv)
library(caret)
```

# Duomenų padalijimas

```{r}
set.seed(4)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df$ProductRelated_Duration, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_df <- df[train_idx, ]
test_df <- df[-train_idx, ]
```

# Spline modeliai

```{r}
df_values <- 3:10
cv_folds  <- createFolds(train_df$ProductRelated_Duration, k = 5)

# Geriausio df parinkimas per kryžminę patikrą (B-Spline)
bs_cv_rmse <- sapply(df_values, function(d) {
  fold_rmse <- sapply(cv_folds, function(idx) {
    tr <- train_df[-idx, ]
    val <- train_df[idx, ]
    m <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ bs(ProductRelated, df = d,
                 Boundary.knots = c(0, max(df$ProductRelated) * 10)) +
                 Administrative + PageValues + VisitorType + Weekend, data = tr)
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = val)
    sqrt(mean((val$ProductRelated_Duration - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  mean(fold_rmse)
})

best_bs_df <- df_values[which.min(bs_cv_rmse)]
cat("Geriausias B-Spline df:", best_bs_df, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Geriausio df parinkimas per kryžminę patikrą (Natural Spline)
ns_cv_rmse <- sapply(df_values, function(d) {
  fold_rmse <- sapply(cv_folds, function(idx) {
    tr <- train_df[-idx, ]
    val <- train_df[idx, ]
    m <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ ns(ProductRelated, df = d,
                 Boundary.knots = c(0, max(df$ProductRelated) * 10)) +
                 Administrative + PageValues + VisitorType + Weekend, data = tr)
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = val)
    sqrt(mean((val$ProductRelated_Duration - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  mean(fold_rmse)
})

best_ns_df <- df_values[which.min(ns_cv_rmse)]
cat("Geriausias Natural Spline df:", best_ns_df, "\n")
```

```{r}
bs_model <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ bs(ProductRelated, df = best_bs_df,
                 Boundary.knots = c(0, max(df$ProductRelated) * 10)) +
                 Administrative + PageValues + VisitorType + Weekend, data = train_df)
ns_model <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ ns(ProductRelated, df = best_ns_df,
                 Boundary.knots = c(0, max(df$ProductRelated) * 10)) +
                 Administrative + PageValues + VisitorType + Weekend, data = train_df)
```

# GAM modelis

```{r}
gam_model <- gam(ProductRelated_Duration ~ s(ProductRelated) + s(Administrative) +
                   s(PageValues) + VisitorType + Weekend,
                 data = train_df, method = "REML")

summary(gam_model)
```

# Lokalios regresijos modelis

```{r}
# Geriausio span parinkimas per kryžminę patikrą
span_values <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)

loess_cv_rmse <- sapply(span_values, function(s) {
  fold_rmse <- sapply(cv_folds, function(idx) {
    tr <- train_df[-idx, ]
    val <- train_df[idx, ]
    m <- loess(ProductRelated_Duration ~ ProductRelated + Administrative + PageValues,
                  data = tr, span = s)
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = val)
    na_idx <- is.na(pred)
    if (any(na_idx)) {
      val_clamped <- val
      num_vars <- names(Filter(is.numeric, tr))
      for (var in num_vars) {
        val_clamped[[var]] <- pmin(val[[var]], max(tr[[var]], na.rm = TRUE))
      }
      pred[na_idx] <- predict(m, newdata = val_clamped)[na_idx]
    }
    sqrt(mean((val$ProductRelated_Duration - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  mean(fold_rmse)
})

best_span <- span_values[which.min(loess_cv_rmse)]
cat("Geriausias span:", best_span, "\n")
```

```{r}
loess_model <- loess(ProductRelated_Duration ~ ProductRelated + Administrative + PageValues,
                     data = train_df, span = best_span)
```

# Modelių palyginimas

```{r}
eval_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
  r2 <- cor(actual, predicted)^2
  mae <- mean(abs(actual - predicted))
  c(RMSE = round(rmse, 2), R2 = round(r2, 4), MAE = round(mae, 2))
}

# Jei po prognozavimo atsiranda NA reikšmės, faktorių reikšmes reikia pakeisti į mokymo duomenų intervalą
clamp_predict <- function(model, newdata, train_data) {
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata)
  na_idx <- is.na(pred)
  if (any(na_idx)) {
    num_vars <- names(Filter(is.numeric, train_data))
    newdata_clamped <- newdata
    for (var in num_vars) {
      rng <- range(train_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      newdata_clamped[[var]] <- pmax(pmin(newdata[[var]], rng[2]), rng[1])
    }
    pred[na_idx] <- predict(model, newdata = newdata_clamped)[na_idx]
  }
  pred
}

bs_pred <- clamp_predict(bs_model, test_df, train_df)
ns_pred <- clamp_predict(ns_model, test_df, train_df)
gam_pred <- clamp_predict(gam_model, test_df, train_df)
loess_pred <- clamp_predict(loess_model, test_df, train_df)

rezultatai <- data.frame(
  Modelis = c("B-Spline", "Natural Spline", "GAM", "Lokalioji regresija"),
  rbind(
    eval_metrics(test_df$ProductRelated_Duration, bs_pred),
    eval_metrics(test_df$ProductRelated_Duration, ns_pred),
    eval_metrics(test_df$ProductRelated_Duration, gam_pred),
    eval_metrics(test_df$ProductRelated_Duration, loess_pred)
  )
)

knitr::kable(rezultatai,
             col.names = c("Modelis", "RMSE", "R²", "MAE"),
             caption   = "Modelių palyginimas testavimo aibėje")
```

```{r}
AIC(bs_model, ns_model, gam_model)
```
